title: Bear cub in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="28" r="12" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="28" r="12" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="28" r="7" fill="#D4956A"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="28" r="7" fill="#D4956A"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="45" rx="28" ry="25" fill="#A0704A"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="14" ry="10" fill="#E8C49A"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="42" r="4" fill="#2A1A0A"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="42" r="4" fill="#2A1A0A"/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="41" r="1.5" fill="#FFEEDD"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="41" r="1.5" fill="#FFEEDD"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="51" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#3A2010"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M46 56 Q50 60 54 56" stroke="#3A2010" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d="M28 65 Q50 72 72 65 L70 72 Q50 79 30 72 Z" fill="#E8433A"/>
  <path d="M28 65 Q50 72 72 65" stroke="#FF7A70" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d="M62 70 Q68 82 64 92 L56 90 Q60 80 55 71 Z" fill="#E8433A"/>
  <path d="M62 70 Q68 82 64 92" stroke="#FF7A70" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <rect x="38" y="68" width="6" height="8" fill="#FFD34D" transform="rotate(4 41 72)"/>
  <rect x="50" y="69" width="6" height="8" fill="#FFD34D" transform="rotate(2 53 73)"/>
  <rect x="60" y="76" width="6" height="7" fill="#FFD34D" transform="rotate(-6 63 80)"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="22" ry="14" fill="#A0704A"/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="92" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#D4956A"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="92" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#D4956A"/>
</svg>
